name: Sugar
health_effects: High consumption is linked to dental caries, obesity, and metabolic risks.

name: Salt
aliases: Sodium Chloride, Table Salt, Sea Salt
health_effects: Essential electrolyte; excessive chronic intake is associated with hypertension.

name: Wheat flour
aliases: Refined Wheat Flour, All-Purpose Flour, White Flour
health_effects: Primary carbohydrate source; contains gluten which triggers celiac disease in sensitive individuals.

name: Palm oil
aliases: Palm Fruit Oil, Fractionated Palm Oil
health_effects: High in saturated palmitic acid; excessive intake may raise LDL cholesterol.

name: Citric acid
health_effects: Naturally occurring organic acid; generally recognized as safe; high concentrations may erode dental enamel.

name: Sodium benzoate
health_effects: Antimicrobial preservative; may form trace benzene when combined with ascorbic acid under heat.

name: Tartrazine
health_effects: Synthetic azo dye; may trigger hyperactivity in sensitive children and mild allergic reactions in aspirin-sensitive individuals.

name: Monosodium glutamate
health_effects: Umami flavour enhancer; recognized as safe by major food safety authorities; mild transient sensitivity reported in rare cases.

name: Aspartame
health_effects: Intense low-calorie sweetener; must be strictly avoided by individuals with phenylketonuria (PKU).

name: Caramel colour
health_effects: Widely used brown colourant; ammonia and sulfite processes (Class III/IV) can produce trace 4-MEI.

name: Soy lecithin
health_effects: Natural phospholipid emulsifier; safe for general population, but may provoke reactions in individuals with severe soy allergies.

name: Gelatin
health_effects: Animal-derived protein; safe for consumption, but not suitable for vegetarians, vegans, or certain religious diets.

name: Milk powder
aliases: Skimmed Milk Powder, Dried Milk, Whole Milk Powder, Casein, Whey
health_effects: Rich in calcium and protein; contains lactose and casein, which trigger lactose intolerance or dairy allergy.

name: Cornstarch
health_effects: Easily digestible carbohydrate thickener; raises blood glucose similarly to other refined starches.

name: Glucose syrup
health_effects: Concentrated carbohydrate solution; high glycemic index that contributes to calorie intake and blood sugar spikes.

name: Vinegar
aliases: Acetic Acid Solution, White Distilled Vinegar
health_effects: Dilute acetic acid solution; safe at dietary levels; can cause irritation in undiluted forms.

name: Baking soda
health_effects: Alkaline leavening agent; contributes to dietary sodium intake.

name: Potassium bromate
health_effects: Oxidizing dough conditioner classified as a possible human carcinogen; banned in the EU, UK, Canada, and India.

name: Titanium dioxide
health_effects: White opacifying pigment; banned as a food additive in the EU following EFSA concerns over nanoparticle genotoxicity.

name: Partially hydrogenated soybean oil
aliases: Industrial Trans Fat, Hydrogenated Soybean Oil
health_effects: Major source of artificial trans-fatty acids; significantly increases cardiovascular disease risk; banned in the US and EU.

name: Azodicarbonamide
health_effects: Dough conditioner and foaming agent; decomposes into semicarbazide upon baking; banned in foods in the EU and Australia.

name: Brominated vegetable oil
health_effects: Weighting agent for citrus beverages; bioaccumulates bromine in tissues; banned in the EU and revoked by US FDA.

name: Amaranth
health_effects: Dark red azo dye; banned in the United States by the FDA since 1976 due to suspected carcinogenicity.

name: Potassium iodate
health_effects: Oxidizing dough improver; banned for food processing in several jurisdictions including India due to thyroid and toxicity concerns.

name: Sodium cyclamate
health_effects: Artificial sweetener; banned in food products in the US since 1970, though permitted in over 50 countries including the EU.

name: Fast Green FCF
health_effects: Sea green triarylmethane dye; banned as a food additive in the European Union.

name: Ponceau 4R
health_effects: Strawberry red azo dye; not approved for food use by the US FDA; permitted with warnings in the EU.

name: Ascorbic acid
health_effects: Essential water-soluble vitamin and antioxidant; prevents food browning and supports immune function.

name: Potassium sorbate
health_effects: Common antifungal and antibacterial preservative; efficiently metabolized by the human body into water and carbon dioxide.

name: Sodium nitrite
health_effects: Inhibits botulinum spores in cured meats; can form carcinogenic nitrosamines when cooked at high heat.

name: Sodium nitrate
aliases: Chile Saltpeter, Nitric Acid Sodium Salt
health_effects: Curing agent in aged meats; breaks down into nitrites over time with similar health considerations.

name: Potassium metabisulfite
health_effects: Sulfite preservative used in winemaking and dried fruit; can provoke severe asthmatic reactions in sulfite-sensitive individuals.

name: Sodium metabisulfite
health_effects: Releases sulfur dioxide gas; inhibits microbial growth; must be declared on labels due to allergen sensitivity.

name: Sulfur dioxide
health_effects: Gaseous food preservative for dried fruits and wine; known trigger for respiratory bronchospasm in asthmatic individuals.

name: Butylated hydroxyanisole
health_effects: Synthetic fat-soluble antioxidant; classified as reasonably anticipated to be a human carcinogen by NTP at high rodent doses.

name: Butylated hydroxytoluene
health_effects: Synthetic phenolic antioxidant; permitted within low legal limits; scrutinized for potential endocrine-disrupting effects.

name: Tert-butylhydroquinone
health_effects: Highly effective preservative for vegetable oils; strictly regulated due to toxicity symptoms observed at high acute doses.

name: Propyl gallate
health_effects: Protects fats from oxidation; may cause mild skin or gastric irritation in sensitive individuals.

name: Tocopherols
health_effects: Natural fat-soluble vitamin antioxidant; protects cells from lipid peroxidation.

name: Sodium diacetate
health_effects: Compound of sodium acetate and acetic acid; inhibits mold and rope in baked goods.

name: Calcium propionate
health_effects: Effective bread mold inhibitor; safe at regulated levels; rare subjective behavioural complaints in sensitive children.

name: Acesulfame potassium
health_effects: Calorie-free artificial sweetener; excreted unchanged by kidneys without metabolic breakdown.

name: Sucralose
health_effects: Chlorinated non-nutritive sweetener; stable under heat; largely unabsorbed by digestive tract.

name: Saccharin
health_effects: Zero-calorie sweetener; past rodent toxicity debates resolved, though high doses may cause unpleasant metallic aftertaste.

name: Steviol glycosides
health_effects: Plant-derived non-caloric sweetener; recognized as safe by WHO, EFSA, and FDA.

name: Sorbitol
health_effects: Sugar alcohol bulk sweetener and humectant; excessive intake can trigger osmotic diarrhea and abdominal cramping.

name: Xylitol
health_effects: Tooth-friendly polyol sweetener; safe for humans with mild laxative threshold; highly toxic and lethal to dogs.

name: Erythritol
health_effects: Zero-calorie polyol with superior digestive tolerance; rapid urinary excretion without intestinal fermentation.

name: Maltitol
health_effects: Sugar alcohol with 90% the sweetness of sucrose; moderate glycemic index; laxative effect at high doses.

name: Xanthan gum
health_effects: Bacterial polysaccharide stabilizer; high amounts can cause mild flatulence or laxative effect.

name: Guar gum
health_effects: Soluble dietary fiber extracted from guar beans; aids digestion; excessive doses may cause bloating.

name: Pectin
health_effects: Naturally occurring plant fiber extracted from citrus peels or apples; supports intestinal gut flora.

name: Agar
health_effects: Red algae-derived vegetarian gelling agent; rich in soluble fiber with mild bulk-laxative properties.

name: Carrageenan
health_effects: Red seaweed extract; food-grade carrageenan is approved, but degraded poligeenan can cause gastrointestinal inflammation.

name: Locust bean gum
health_effects: Galactomannan vegetable gum extracted from carob tree seeds; safe stabilizing thickener.

name: Arabic gum
health_effects: Natural exudate gum from Acacia trees; serves as a prebiotic soluble fiber.

name: Mono- and diglycerides of fatty acids
health_effects: Common bakery and dairy emulsifier; metabolized like natural dietary fats; may contain trace trans fats if from hydrogenated oils.

name: Polysorbate 80
health_effects: Synthetic non-ionic surfactant; animal studies suggest potential alteration of intestinal mucosal barrier at high intakes.

name: Polysorbate 60
health_effects: Food emulsifier used in baked goods; generally recognized as safe within established acceptable daily intake.

name: Sodium carboxymethyl cellulose
health_effects: Non-digestible plant cellulose derivative; safe stabilizer; passes through digestive tract largely unchanged.

name: Sodium alginate
health_effects: Extracted from brown seaweed; forms thermo-irreversible gels in the presence of calcium ions.

name: Allura Red AC
health_effects: Synthetic azo red dye; subject to mandatory cautionary labeling in the EU regarding attention in children.

name: Sunset Yellow FCF
aliases: FD&C Yellow No. 6, Orange Yellow S
health_effects: Synthetic petroleum-derived orange azo dye; associated with urticaria and hyperactivity symptoms in sensitive individuals.

name: Brilliant Blue FCF
health_effects: Synthetic triarylmethane dye; poorly absorbed in the gastrointestinal tract and largely excreted intact.

name: Indigotine
health_effects: Dark blue organic salt food dye; deemed safe within established acceptable daily intake.

name: Curcumin
health_effects: Natural yellow polyphenolic pigment isolated from turmeric rhizomes; exhibits antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties.

name: Beetroot red
health_effects: Natural red glycosidic food dye extracted from red beets; harmless and non-toxic.

name: Chlorophylls
health_effects: Natural green photosynthetic plant pigments; safe natural colouring agent.

name: Lactic acid
health_effects: Natural organic acid produced by fermentation; safe preservative and pH buffer.

name: Malic acid
health_effects: Tart organic dicarboxylic acid found in sour apples; naturally involved in the Krebs cycle.

name: Tartaric acid
health_effects: Natural organic acid prominent in grapes and wine; gives tart flavour and acts as antioxidant synergist.

name: Phosphoric acid
health_effects: Inorganic mineral acid used in colas; high dietary consumption can disrupt calcium-phosphorus bone homeostasis.

name: Disodium inosinate
health_effects: Umami ribonucleotide synergist commonly paired with MSG; metabolizes to purines, requiring moderation in gout patients.

name: Disodium guanylate
health_effects: Nucleotide flavour enhancer producing savory taste; naturally broken down into harmless uric acid precursors.

name: Yeast extract
health_effects: Natural source of free glutamic acid and savory umami flavour; rich in B-complex vitamins.

name: Hydrolyzed vegetable protein
health_effects: Savory seasoning obtained by acid hydrolysis of vegetable proteins; potential soy/wheat allergen source.

name: Glycerol
health_effects: Naturally occurring trihydroxy alcohol; retains moisture and softens texture; non-toxic and easily metabolized.

name: Polydextrose
health_effects: Low-calorie synthetic polymer of glucose; functions as soluble prebiotic dietary fiber.

name: Silicon dioxide
health_effects: Prevents clumping in powdered foods; insoluble and biologically inert when consumed orally.

name: Calcium carbonate
health_effects: Dietary calcium mineral supplement, pH buffer, and white surface pigment; harmless at food intake levels.
